methodology_notes.volume: No keyword-volume tool available; volume fields are null. Pillar choice based on SERP breadth and business fit, not measured volume.
methodology_notes.thresholds: 7-10 same post | 4-6 same cluster | 2-3 interlink | 0-1 separate
methodology_notes.accepted_deviation: Most spoke pairs score 0-1. Hubs are justified by site taxonomy and funnel (learn -> price -> sell), not by SERP co-ranking. Low overlap confirms each spoke is a distinct ranking target with no cannibalization risk.
